t.E425.agn: In 2017 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI); it considered use at up to 10 g/kg acceptable as long as total intake from all sources remains below 3 g per day. In adults taking 3,000 mg per day for 12 weeks, abdominal discomfort (diarrhoea or constipation) has been reported in some people, and oesophageal obstruction has been reported when taken as tablets without sufficient fluid.
t.E425.body: Konjac is absorbed very little in the gut and is largely fermented by bacteria in the large intestine.
t.E425.eff.0.t: Oesophageal obstruction has been reported when taken as tablets without sufficient fluid; in the EU its use in jelly confectionery is prohibited
t.E425.eff.1.t: Abdominal discomfort (diarrhoea or constipation) has been reported
t.E425.eval: It thickens and forms a gel. In 2017 EFSA saw no need for a numerical ADI; it considered its use acceptable as long as total intake from all sources remains below 3 g per day. The EU banned konjac jelly confectionery (including jelly mini-cups) in 2003 because of choking incidents.
t.E425.found.0: In the EU, permitted in many foods at up to 10 g/kg (not in jelly confectionery)
t.E425.prod: It is obtained from the tuber of the konjac plant.
t.E425.pw.0: The EU banned konjac jelly confectionery (including jelly mini-cups) in 2003 because it caused choking incidents in children and elderly people in third countries.
t.E425.pw.1: The EU banned konjac jelly confectionery (including jelly mini-cups) in 2003 because it caused choking incidents in children and elderly people in third countries.
t.E425.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, provided that total intake from all sources remains below 3 g per day.
t.E425.regx.1: Use in jelly confectionery, including jelly mini-cups, was prohibited (because of choking incidents in children and elderly people).
t.E425.regx.2: Up to 10 g/kg in Group I; not permitted in jelly mini-cups, jelly confectionery or dehydrated foods intended to swell with water when swallowed.
t.E425.summary: A fibre (glucomannan) obtained from the tuber of the konjac plant. It provides thickness in jellies, noodles and diet products.
t.E425.what: It thickens and forms a gel.
